deploy-bot: [DEPLOY BLOCKED] Attempted rollout rc9 -> prod. Reason: SBOM signature missing for registry.redwood.com/runtime:rc9. Vulnerability scan: 1 LOW transitive CVE. Change window ends in ~1h. Pinging @sam @evan.

sam (release): quick options? rollback, pin-canary, or exception? We need a call in 30m.

evan (security): low severity, no exploit. Preferred: short, timeboxed canary pinned to digest for EU only with monitoring. Require audit note and timebox (8h).

maria (qa): can run smoke + core-regression in ~20m for a small canary.

sam (release): can someone check the registry for the digest and signature?

sam (release): ```
$ skopeo inspect docker://registry.redwood.com/runtime:rc9
Digest: sha256:baadf00d1234567890abcdefabcdef1234567890
Signatures: none
SBOM: present
```

evan (security): digest exists but unsigned. I'm OK with an 8h EU-only pin at 5% traffic if we set auto-rollback: errors>1% OR p50 latency>25% over baseline (5m). Add verbose logging.

legal: approved with audit note required. Add ticket REL-5012 to release notes. Timebox enforced.

sam (release): decision: proceed EU-only canary pinned to sha256:baadf00d... at 5% traffic, expire 8h. QA runs smoke; security/legal approved.

sam (release): carveout command: ```bash
deploybot carveout --region eu-west-1 --image "registry.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:baadf00d1234567890abcdefabcdef1234567890" --traffic 5% --rollback-if "errors>1% or p50>25%" --expire 8h
```

deploy-bot: carving out canary to eu-west-1 using pinned digest sha256:baadf00d... Traffic: 5%. Auto-rollback and expiry set. Monitoring -> #eng-oncall + #security.

maria (qa): smoke started, first quick checks look clean (no 5xx spike). Regression subset queued (ETA 18m).

deploy-bot: [LOG] canary-start ts=1717200300 status=running instances=4 health=4 traffic=5%

(THREAD END)
